phases.title: Foundations
phases.blurb: Cost, then the one structure everything else is built on. Nothing here is optional.

phases.title: Data Structures
phases.blurb: Ten shapes for holding data, and the trade each one makes to be fast at something.

phases.title: Algorithms
phases.blurb: Recursion, backtracking and greedy choices, then recursion with a memo — plus the sweep-line, bit and number tricks that are pure technique.

phases.title: Systems
phases.blurb: What happens once one machine is not enough — and once one thread is not either.

phases.title: The Rest of the Loop
phases.blurb: The two rounds that are not about algorithms: object design, and telling a true story well.

phases.title: AI & ML
phases.blurb: Embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, agents — the round that did not exist five years ago.

modules.title: Big-O

modules.title: Arrays
modules.blurb: Pointers, windows and in-place tricks, drawn out step by step.

modules.title: Strings
modules.blurb: Characters in a row — palindromes, windows, and the hashing that finds a needle fast.

modules.title: Searching
modules.blurb: Watch a search space collapse until only the answer is left.

modules.title: Sorting
modules.blurb: See why the clever sorts beat the obvious ones.

modules.title: Linked Lists

modules.title: Stacks & Queues

modules.title: Hash Tables
modules.blurb: Trade a bit of memory for answers in constant time.

modules.title: Recursion
modules.blurb: Watch the call stack grow, shrink, and finally make sense.

modules.title: Backtracking
modules.blurb: Try a choice, go deeper, undo it — and prune the branches that cannot win.

modules.title: Greedy
modules.blurb: Take the best local move and see exactly when that is enough.

modules.title: Trees & BST
modules.blurb: Hierarchies, ordered searches, and the paths between nodes.

modules.title: Tries

modules.title: Heaps

modules.title: Graphs
modules.blurb: Nodes, edges, and the searches that ripple across them.

modules.title: Matrix & Grid
modules.blurb: Rows, columns and neighbours — the grid problems interviews keep drawing.

modules.title: Union-Find
modules.blurb: Merge groups in near-constant time, then ask who belongs together.

modules.title: Intervals
modules.blurb: Sort by start, sweep once — merges, overlaps and meeting rooms fall out.

modules.title: Bit Manipulation

modules.title: Math & Number Theory

modules.title: Dynamic Programming
modules.blurb: Solve every subproblem once, then let the table do the work.

modules.title: System Design
modules.blurb: Scale, cache, shard — and know what each choice costs you.

modules.title: System Design Cases
modules.blurb: Design a URL shortener, a chat app, a feed — the interview round, end to end.

modules.title: AI & ML
modules.blurb: From embeddings to agents — see how modern AI actually works.

modules.title: Low-Level Design
modules.blurb: Objects, interfaces and patterns that survive the follow-up question.

modules.title: Concurrency

modules.title: SQL

modules.title: Behavioral
